decisions.statement: A rule's page is slugged `rule-` and the id the rule has.
Where a rule falls among the rules is written as its display order.
A condition value is written as JSON except where the value is text no JSON reader would take.
A rule saying nothing about being switched on is written as switched on.
An action and a goal are written by the page type and slug naming each.
A condition field is written by the page type and slug naming the field.
A rule saying nothing about when the rule changed is written as the epoch.
A rule carrying no switch state and no change time comes back switched on and dated the epoch.

definition: a rule a player has written out as a page and the entries beside it
